title: First Report
summary: Write a Quarto document: a YAML header, a hidden setup chunk that reads the Crew Log, and sentences whose numbers come from inline R.
hints: The YAML header needs `title: "Crew Log Report"` between the two `---` lines.
In the setup chunk, add `#| include: false` under `#| label: setup`, then `library(readr)` and `crew <- read_csv("astronauts.csv", show_col_types = FALSE)`.
